description: NEXA-M2-006 calibration set: questions the PNG STEM curriculum corpus does not answer. Used with the M2-003 gold set (answerable) to set the evidence thresholds, so that NEXA says it found nothing instead of answering from general knowledge. Mix of off-curriculum questions in learner wording and on-subject questions the corpus does not cover. A hit is any retrieved passage; the target is evidence level 'none' or at most 'weak'.
